title: AIDRA — Tip & Cue Replay
description: Autonomous re-tasking chains: every time AIDRA detects a low-confidence vessel cluster, it queues a re-observation cue (T0 → Cue → T1). Each row links to a side-by-side visual replay with SAR thumbnails before/after and confidence uplift. This is the SatCen tender extra.

list.name: api_base
list.label: API base URL
list.description: Base URL of the AIDRA REST API used for thumbnails and replay links. Edit in the toolbar (or override via ?var-api_base=...) when running this dashboard against a non-production deployment.

options.content:
**Tip & Cue** is AIDRA's autonomous re-tasking loop. When a pipeline run produces a low-or-moderate-confidence detection cluster in a zone of interest, the evaluator queues a `cue` to **re-observe** the same area in the next satellite pass. Each row below is a chain `T0 → Cue → T1`.

- **T0** = the original execution that triggered the cue.
- **Cue** = the re-tasking entry (target zone, priority, reason).
- **T1** = the re-observation execution: a run on a scene **sensed after** T0's. Until Copernicus publishes one the cue waits in the queue (`awaiting_new_scene`); if none arrives in time it closes as `expired`.

Click **▶ Open replay** to see a visual side-by-side comparison: SAR thumbnails of the triggering detections vs. the confirming detections, with confidence uplift and latency metrics. This is the SatCen tender extra: the satellite chasing its own findings.

> Cues created before **2026-05-11** are hidden so the operational KPIs reflect the post-fix build (after the Tip & Cue zone-mapping incident, migrations 013/014). The failed rows are kept in the database for traceability; log in to Grafana to query the full history.

> Only cues whose T1 ran on a later scene count as **re-observed**. Cues closed before **2026-11-17** mostly re-processed their own scene or were skipped (`result = skipped`); they are kept for traceability and show `re_observed = no`.

panels.title: Cues in window
panels.description: Total cues created in the selected time range, filtered by the Cue status variable above (default 'all' shows full history).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cues
FROM tasking_queue
WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND created_at >= '2026-05-11T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND (LEFT('$status', 1) = '$' OR '$status' = 'all' OR status = '$status')

panels.title: Waiting now (live backlog)
panels.description: Cues still open — ignores the time range and the status filter. Most are waiting for Copernicus to publish a scene sensed after the one that raised them; they are re-checked periodically and expire if none arrives.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS waiting
FROM tasking_queue
WHERE status = 'pending'
  AND attempts < max_attempts

panels.title: Re-observed (later scene)
panels.description: Cues closed by a successful run on a scene sensed after the one that raised them (T1 later than T0). A cue whose run was skipped, or that re-processed its own scene, is not a re-observation and is not counted.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS re_observed
FROM tasking_queue t
JOIN execution_log e0 ON e0.id = t.triggered_by
JOIN execution_log e1 ON e1.id = t.execution_id
WHERE t.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND t.created_at >= '2026-05-11T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND t.status = 'completed'
  AND e1.status = 'success' AND e1.image_sensing_date > e0.image_sensing_date

panels.title: Avg triggering detections
panels.description: Mean number of detections per cue (the cluster size that fired the re-tasking).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(cardinality(triggering_detections))::numeric, 1) AS avg_dets
FROM tasking_queue
WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND created_at >= '2026-05-11T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND (LEFT('$status', 1) = '$' OR '$status' = 'all' OR status = '$status')

panels.title: Top zones by cues
panels.description: Which zones of interest fire the most re-tasking events.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(target_zone, 'unknown') AS zone, COUNT(*) AS cues
FROM tasking_queue
WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND created_at >= '2026-05-11T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND (LEFT('$status', 1) = '$' OR '$status' = 'all' OR status = '$status')
GROUP BY target_zone
ORDER BY cues DESC
LIMIT 8

panels.title: Tip & Cue chains (click ▶ Open replay)
panels.description: Each row is a re-tasking cue. Click '▶ Open replay' to see the visual T0 → Cue → T1 walkthrough with SAR thumbnails before / after and confidence uplift. 're_observed' = yes only when T1 succeeded on a scene sensed after T0's; 'result' awaiting_new_scene = still waiting for that scene, no_new_scene = expired without one.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    'https://aidra-api.uliber.com/api/tipcue/replay/' || t.id || '.html' AS "replay",
    t.created_at                                  AS "cue_at",
    t.status                                      AS "status",
    COALESCE(t.target_zone, '—')                  AS "zone",
    t.priority                                    AS "prio",
    cardinality(t.triggering_detections)          AS "trigger_dets",
    CASE WHEN t.status = 'completed' AND e1.status = 'success' AND e1.image_sensing_date > e0.image_sensing_date THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS "re_observed",
    COALESCE(t.confirmed_detections, 0)           AS "confirmed",
    COALESCE(t.result_status, t.status)           AS "result",
    t.attempts                                    AS "attempts",
    COALESCE(t.reason, '')                        AS "reason",
    COALESCE(t.last_error, '')                    AS "last_error",
    t.id::text                                    AS "tasking_id"
FROM tasking_queue t
LEFT JOIN execution_log e0 ON e0.id = t.triggered_by
LEFT JOIN execution_log e1 ON e1.id = t.execution_id
WHERE t.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND t.created_at >= '2026-05-11T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  AND (LEFT('$status', 1) = '$' OR '$status' = 'all' OR t.status = '$status')
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100
